name: MODIS MCD64A1 Burned Area Monthly Global 500m
description: MCD64A1 Version 6.1 is the standard MODIS monthly burned area product produced at 500-meter spatial resolution by the Land Processes DAAC. Fusing Terra and Aqua surface reflectance observations with 1-kilometer active fire detections using a hybrid algorithm, MCD64A1 maps the approximate burn date (day of year) and burn uncertainty for every 500m pixel globally from November 2000 to the present. The product serves as the primary empirical constraint for global fire emissions inventories (including GFED) and global carbon accounting.
